about_the_game:
Cursed Bloodline

An investigation that turns into pure hell. Enter the house where every missing person left a trace — and you might be the next.

Genre: Psychological Horror / Narrative Drama
Mode: Single-player, story-driven
Perspective: First-person
Key Features: Heavy atmosphere, mo-cap animations, original sound recordings, linear chapter-based gameplay

Story

You are a small-town detective known for solving tough cases. Your new assignment leads you to a house with no known owner, yet countless people have gone missing inside. Once you enter, reality twists, hallucinations take over, and soon you realize: you are not the investigator — the house is watching you.

Gameplay

  • Explore a haunted house where every object, sound, and flicker uncovers a piece of the chilling mystery.

  • Linear, chapter-based progression with escalating horror.

  • Real mo-cap animations for lifelike movement and facial expressions.

  • Dynamic scares — you never know what’s scripted and what’s just happening.

  • Audio captured in real locations for authentic fear.ű

What Makes It Unique?

  • Original story blending real crime investigation with psychological terror.

  • AAA-level motion capture in an indie game.

  • 100% UI-free experience — no HUD, no hints, only raw immersion.

  • Each chapter brings a different horror style, keeping you off-balance.

Atmosphere

  • Oppressive tension from start to finish.

  • Fear grounded in realism — what you hear could easily be real.

  • Minimalistic visuals that make every detail unnerving.

If you enjoyed Visage, Outlast, or Layers of Fear — this is your next nightmare.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: A psychological horror where you uncover the dark secret of a cursed bloodline. Echoes of the past and horrifying realities guide you through the abandoned house. But beware—you’re not the only one searching for answers.

English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Czech, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Hungarian, Russian, Portuguese - Portugal, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
